name: insights-review
title: Insights review
description: Use this skill when reviewing a supplied rendered insights report and consolidating independent proposal packets for minimal changes to src/rules/**/*.md or src/skills/**.
when: When reviewing or consolidating a rendered insights report
do-not-use-when: Generating Codex rollout insights artefacts or a rendered report — use codex-insights
Reviewing a code diff or pull request — use code-review
Reviewing a task contract before implementation — use project-review-task
Applying a confirmed rule or skill change — use the normal implementation workflow
